text:
Rae: Quick RFC follow-up: propose extracting the router's inlined counting into a tiny Quota-Lease service (name: quota-lease) that issues short-lived leases to the router. thoughts?

Tom: what's the primary win? lower tail latency or clearer audit trail?

Rae: both. router currently does decode->auth->count->quota in hot path. Counting spikes are visible at P99 and add jitter. Also billing needs a clean, replayable surface.

Aria: lease model? optimistic fast leases or synchronous reservations?

Rae: hybrid: router obtains a micro-lease (local decision) from a cached lease table. If the micro-lease can't satisfy the tokens it calls QuotaLease.reserve(request_id, tokens) which is strongly consistent. The idea is most requests use cheap leases, few hit reserve.

Ken: how small are micro-leases? per-tenant token buckets with tiny burst allowances and TTL ~500ms?

Rae: yes, sketch: bucket size = min(ceil(tenant_qps*0.1), 200 tokens), ttl=500ms. conservative to limit overshoot.

Tom: need failure semantics. If QuotaLease down do we fail-open? tag requests?

Aria: plan: default fail-open but annotate request with `quota:uncertain`. Oncall should get divergence alerts. Enterprise tenants can opt-in to fail-closed. No silent failures.

Ken: event durability: router still emits idempotent accounting events to Kafka. QuotaLease writes to commit-log on reserve success. Replays allowed.

Rae: agree. Also add sequence numbers + X-Req-Id for dedupe. SDK change requested.

Tom: migration phases?

Rae: phase A: emit-only events + keep inline counts. phase B: read-side aggregates + dashboards. phase C: enable micro-lease path behind flag for a small tenant cohort. phase D: enable reserve for more tenants, monitor divergence, then retire inline.

Aria: metrics: router-lease-hit-rate, divergence-per-tenant, reserve-latency (P50/P95/P99), kafka-lost-events, consumer-lag. Set alerts for divergence > 0.5% sustained.

Ken: SLOs proposal: reserve P50 < 3ms, P99 < 12ms. Ingest durability ack < 2s for 99.9%. Consumer processing lag < 15s.

Tom: security: QuotaLease becomes audit-sensitive. Use mTLS, HMAC envelopes for events, immutable audit sink.

Rae: deployment: quota-lease as small sharded statefulset keyed by tenant-hash. Start with 4 shards, can scale. Canary with non-critical tenants first.

ci-bot: deploy requested: feature/quota-lease -> staging (ci-4521) :rocket:

Aria: I'll draft the runbook: backout steps include toggling router to inline-counting and pausing consumer consumers. Also provide a manual replay tool.

Ken: I'll handle partitioning plan and shard rebalancing notes. Rae: please update RFC link when ready.

Rae: RFC draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/4112233445-quota-lease-extract (WIP). Thanks all :thumbsup:
